author: World of Warcraft
description:
THE BITTER TRUTH | World of Warcraft 

An unexpected meeting intended for diplomacy places two longtime foes in a tense, drink-fueled standoff where the polite exchanges mask a long history of bloodshed and blame. As the conversation takes a personal turn, both men are forced to confront the painful truth behind their shared history. 

Join Lor’themar and Torundo the Grizzled for a special fireside telling of our newest short story, "The Bitter Truth”. This is Part Three, “The Dregs”.  

For a downloadable PDF, visit: https://blizz.ly/3RfXrxo

Written by Robert Brooks 

Illustrated by Surfside 3D 

Narrated by Gideon Emery as Lor’themar and Keston John as Torundo the Grizzled
